## Service: email-isv (Email ISV API v3)

Documentation for Email ISV API

**API Version v3**

All APIs available via `/v3` route prefix with AIP-compliant responses.

### Email Verification
POST /email/verify
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/email/verify
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/email-isv/verify-email | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/email-isv/verify-email.md

Verify Email

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: lc-email.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "5DP4iH6HLkQsiKESj6rh") - Location Id, The email verification charges will be deducted from this location (if rebilling is enabled) / company wallet

Request body (required) (application/json) VerificationBodyDto:
- type* string (enum: email | contact; e.g. "email") - Email Verification type
- verify* string (e.g. "abc@xyz.com") - Email Verification recepient (email address / contactId)

Response 201 (Successful response) application/json:
- (root) object | object | object
  - option 1 EmailVerifiedV3ResponseDto: object
    - reason string[] - Reason for email verification failure
    - result* string (enum: deliverable | undeliverable | do_not_send | unknown | catch_all) - Email verification result
    - risk* string (enum: high | low | medium | unknown) - Risk level of email sending to bounce
    - address* string - Email address
    - leadConnectorRecommendation object - Lead Connector email verification recommendation
      - isEmailValid boolean - Email verification status
  - option 2 EmailNotVerifiedResponseDto: object
    - verified* boolean - Email verification not processed
    - message string - Email verification failure message
    - address string - Email address
  - option 3 LeadConnectorRecommendationDto: object
    - isEmailValid boolean - Email verification status

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)
